_note: Source of truth for projects.html. Edit here, then run: python3 tools/build_projects.py. Badges: PyPI version and pepy downloads come from 'pypi' (set 'pepy': false until pepy.tech lists the package), conda from 'conda', crates.io from 'crate' (only if a Rust crate exists), DOI from 'zenodo' (concept DOI only). A card may use 'images' (a list, stacked) instead of 'image'.

projects.name: pyCoreRelator
projects.label: Python · Stratigraphic correlation
projects.description: A Python toolkit for pairwise stratigraphic correlation analysis among sediment cores and well-log data.

image.alt: Flowchart of the pyCoreRelator correlation workflow.

projects.citation: Lai, L.S.-H., Sylvester, Z., Covault, J.A., Gomberg, J.S., Nieminski, N.M. (Accepted 2026) Reproducible event-bed correlation with uncertainty: pyCoreRelator. Sedimentology.
